subject: [PATCH v4 09/13] mm/collapse: separate scanning a PTE table from collapsing it

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewer Zi Yan noted that the comments in the code need to address the eligible_ptes bitmap separately for file and anonymous tables, but otherwise approved the patch
reviews.raw_body:
They are used by file only.

I think the comments need to address them separately.

Otherwise, LGTM.

Acked-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>



-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch separates the scanning of a PTE table from collapsing it into two distinct functions: collapse_scan_pmd() and collapse_run_pmd(). The scan function determines whether a range is worth collapsing, while the run function performs the actual collapse. This change improves performance by reducing the number of times the mmap_lock is dropped and taken, and also simplifies the code by breaking down complex operations into smaller, more manageable pieces.

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary:
Reviewer David (Arm) pointed out naming inconsistencies between collapse_scan_pmd and its callees, as well as between collapse_run_pmd and its callees, suggesting a more consistent naming scheme where collapse_scan_pmd calls collapse_scan_file and collapse_scan_anon, and collapse_run_pmd is renamed to collapse_anon or collapse_file.

Reviewer David suggested removing a comment from collapse_control struct documentation, implying it will be removed entirely in the same commit
reviews.raw_body:
I raised that I don't like the "run" in collapse_run_pmd(). That hasn't changed,
as we are adding more inconsistency.

We do have after your patch set

	collapse_scan_pmd calling
	-> collapse_scan_file
	-> collapse_scan_anon_pmd

Inconsistency: why not simply collapse_scan_anon? Alternatively
collapse_scan_file_pmd, although for this internal helper including the "pmd" is
not particularly helpful.

The we have

	collapse_run_pmd calling
	-> mthp_collapse
	-> collapse_file

Inconsistency: a lot, including the "run" thing.


So I suggest the following in the context of this patch here:

	collapse_scan_pmd
	-> collapse_scan_file
	-> collapse_scan_anon

	collapse_pmd
	-> collapse_anon
	-> collapse_file

(as I previously said, "scanned" could be thrown in there, to make the
expectation clearer, but I don't particularly care about that)

---

I'd just not add that doc if you intend to remove the whole thing in the same
comment.


-- 
Cheers,

David
